title: Analytic: isothermal GST anneal, JMAK crystallinity and mixed permittivity (FDFD + transient heat)
description:
A y-periodic 0.4 x 0.1 um strip of GST-225 (phase_change_medium on every cell, GST-225 kinetics, linear mixing) is held at T_anneal: transient, insulated heat with T0 = T_anneal and no source, so T stays T_anneal exactly; heat_em_phase_change hands T and the heat time to the medium after every 10 ns heat step and the sourceless em_fdfd_ez re-solves (1 us run, sweep T_anneal = 560..620 K).
Analytic (JMAK with the capped Arrhenius rate): X(t) = 1 - exp(-(k t)^n), k(T) = exp(min(-Ea / kB (1/T - 1/T_fast), 0)) / tau_min for T_x <= T < T_melt (Ea 2.24 eV, T_fast 650 K, tau_min 50 ns, n 2.5): tau = 1/k runs from 31 us at 560 K to 0.35 us at 620 K, so X(1 us) sweeps from 2e-4 to ~1. Linear mix: eps_r = (1 - X)(n_a^2 - k_a^2) + X (n_c^2 - k_c^2), sigma_e = [(1 - X) 2 n_a k_a + X 2 n_c k_c] omega eps0 at 1.55 um.
Probes tab: em.pcm (mean crystallinity at every heat step) with the dashed JMAK curve X(t) (Sweep tab, Result em.pcm: every T_anneal with its own dashed curve).
Sweep tab: X_end (sigmoid vs T_anneal), eps_mean and sigma_mean with their dashed references.
Line profile tab: eps_profile (em.eps_r) and X_profile (em.crystallinity) across the strip.
Expected: ~1e-4 relative or better (JMAK additivity makes the stepped X exact; float32 storage of X, eps and sigma_e).

parameters.name: dt_heat
parameters.description: heat time step [s] (100 crystallinity updates; JMAK is exact for any step)

parameters.name: lambda_ref
parameters.description: wavelength of the optical constants and of the FDFD solve

parameters.name: k_rate
parameters.description: JMAK rate k(T_anneal) [1/s]: capped Arrhenius, valid for T_onset <= T_anneal < T_melt (0 below the onset)

parameters.name: X_ref
parameters.description: analytic crystallinity at the end of the anneal

parameters.name: eps_amorph
parameters.description: Re eps of the amorphous phase

parameters.name: eps_cryst
parameters.description: Re eps of the crystalline phase

parameters.name: omega_ref
parameters.description: angular frequency of the reference wavelength [rad/s]

parameters.name: eps_mix_ref
parameters.description: analytic eps_r of the linear mix at X_ref

parameters.name: sigma_mix_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_e [S/m] = -Im eps omega eps0 of the linear mix at X_ref

parameters.name: Lx
parameters.description: strip length along x (CPML for the EM)
